summary.result: Test results show that the strengths are increased with increase of the content of natural gravel, excellent soil compound and polypropylene fiber.
summary.background: The coefficient of permeability is increased with increase of the content of the polypropylene fiber but it is decreased with increase of the content of natural gravel and excellent soil compound.
summary.method: The lowest coefficient of permeability is achieved by eco-concrete which it is 100 times lower than that of the control.
